tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Search the JoJ API marketplace (jojapi.com) — scraping, web search, social media and real-world data APIs, all callable with one API key through one gateway. Returns matching APIs with their slugs and links.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Overview of one marketplace API by slug: what it does, its endpoint list, plans and links (docs, OpenAPI, dedicated MCP server).

tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.description: Complete documentation for one endpoint of a marketplace API: parameters with types and requirements, request body, documented responses with examples, and billing.

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Execute one endpoint of a marketplace API through the live gateway. Requires a JoJ API key configured on this MCP connection as an HTTP header (Authorization: Bearer jk_...). Usage is billed to the key's subscription exactly like any other API call.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "call_endpoint" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
